title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 207 (Revocation and renunciation may be expressed or implied)

content.overview: Revocation and renunciation may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the principal or agent respectively.
content.glance: Revocation (by principal) and renunciation (by agent) may be express or implied from conduct.
content.study: Revocation and renunciation may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the principal or agent respectively. Example of implied revocation: A empowers B to let A’s house; afterwards A lets it himself — implied revocation of B’s authority.

sections.heading: Express or implied
sections.body: Revocation and renunciation may be expressed or implied in the conduct of the principal or agent respectively.

provisions.title: Revocation and renunciation may be expressed or implied

examples.title: Implied revocation
examples.body: A empowers B to let A’s house. Afterwards A lets it himself. This is an implied revocation of B’s authority.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 207 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Identify express words or conduct implying revocation or renunciation.
